<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Hiring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hiring" name="Hiring process" processRef="Process_Hiring"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidate" name="Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewInvitation" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CandidatePreference" name="Interview preference" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Hiring">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostJob</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ScreenResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCandidates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCandidates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceivePreference</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewPreference</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InPersonInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VirtualInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseCandidate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExtendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NegotiationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateSalary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NegotiationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Onboarding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Integrated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePreference" name="Receive candidate interview preference"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Interview preference"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" name="Salary negotiations?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Conduct salary negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Onboarding" name="Complete onboarding">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Onboarding"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideOrientation" name="Provide orientation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarding"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Onboarding" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_2" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrientation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_3" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarding"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="Onboarding completed and new hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_2" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_3" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_4" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_5" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_6" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_8" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePreference" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview_InPerson" name="In-person preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">preference = 'in-person'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview_Virtual" name="Virtual preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">preference = 'virtual'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview_InPerson_Merge" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview_Virtual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_10" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_11" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_12" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiation_Yes" name="Negotiations take place" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">salaryNegotiationsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiation_No" name="No negotiations" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_13" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_14" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="SubProcess_Onboarding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hiring_15" sourceRef="SubProcess_Onboarding" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
